QuestInfo.0: The Great Spirit has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: The Great Spirit has a gift for you.

0.0: I can sense that your power has grown mighty enough to ward off the darkness. May your journey be blessed, O Ruler of the Elves.

no.0: What a shame... Return to me if you change your mind.

yes.0: All that remains is for you to continue to regain your powers, until the day they are completely restored... It will be more difficult than anything you've faced, but I believe you'll be victorious. I wish you the best of luck.
